name: Dellos Quote & Estimate Builder
author: dellosenterprises

sections.description:
Quote Builder lets you create interactive price calculators and quote forms for your WordPress site — without writing a single line of code.

Perfect for trades, agencies, freelancers, print shops, event planners, and any business that gives quotes or estimates.

Key Features

  • Drag-and-drop builder — add and reorder fields visually
  • 5 field types — Text, Line Item (qty x price), Dropdown, Radio, Multi-Select
  • 3 contact field types — Name, Email, Phone (for lead capture)
  • Live preview — see exactly what visitors will see as you build
  • Real-time totals — prices update instantly as visitors fill the form
  • Email gate — optionally require visitors to enter their email to receive their quote, turning your calculator into a lead generation tool
  • Quote emails — beautifully formatted quote emailed to the visitor automatically
  • Admin notifications — get notified by email every time someone requests a quote
  • Multiple admin emails — notify multiple team members, comma-separated
  • Multi-currency — GBP, USD, EUR, INR, AED, AUD, CAD, SGD, ZAR, JPY, or custom
  • Pricing rules — add markup %, discount %, or minimum price
  • Custom formula — advanced users can write custom pricing formulas
  • Shortcode — embed anywhere with [quotecalc id=”1″]
  • Works with all page builders — Elementor, Divi, Beaver Builder, WPBakery, and any shortcode-compatible builder
  • Responsive — looks great on mobile, tablet, and desktop
  • Duplicate calculators — copy an existing calculator as a starting point
  • i18n ready — fully internationalised and translation ready

How It Works

  1. Go to Quote Builder → Add New in your WordPress admin
  2. Add fields — line items, dropdowns, radio buttons, etc.
  3. Set prices for each field or option
  4. Choose your currency and pricing rules
  5. Copy the shortcode and paste it into any page or post
  6. Visitors fill out the form and get an instant price estimate

Email Gate (Lead Generation)

Enable the Email Gate in the Settings tab to require visitors to submit their contact details before receiving their quote. The quote is emailed to them automatically, and you receive a lead notification with their details and selections.

Embed

Use the shortcode on any page or post:
[quotecalc id=”1″]

Works in Elementor (Shortcode widget), Gutenberg (Shortcode block), Divi, Beaver Builder, and all other page builders.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the dellos-quote-builder folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress
  3. Go to Quote Builder in your admin sidebar
  4. Click Add New to create your first calculator
sections.faq:
Does this work with Elementor?

Yes. Use the Shortcode widget in Elementor and paste [quotecalc id="X"].

Can I have multiple calculators on the same site?

Yes. Create as many calculators as you need, each with its own shortcode.

Does it send emails automatically?

Yes, when Email Gate is enabled. The plugin uses your site’s existing email configuration (wp_mail). If your site already sends emails, Quote Builder will too.

Can I notify multiple people when a quote is submitted?

Yes. Enter multiple email addresses separated by commas in the admin notification field.

What currencies are supported?

GBP, USD, EUR, INR, AED, AUD, CAD, SGD, ZAR, JPY, and a custom option where you can enter any symbol.

Can I add a markup or discount?

Yes. The Pricing tab lets you add a markup %, discount %, or minimum price to any calculator.

Is there a pro version?

Not yet. Quote Builder is currently free and open source. A pro version with Stripe integration, WooCommerce support, PDF quotes, conditional logic, and more is planned.

  • Admin notifications with multiple email support
